scores.label: A
scores.note: 'extirpated' is too rare for the essay; 'annihilated' is too odd/hyperbolic for a disease; 'diseases have been cleared' is unidiomatic

scores.label: B
scores.note: 'banned' and 'abolished' are the wrong sense (laws, not diseases); 'cured' is wrong sense (patients are cured, a disease is not wiped out by cure); 'overcome' does not mean the disease is gone

scores.label: C
scores.note: 'annihilated' is too odd for a disease; 'canceled', 'annulled' and 'ruined' are the wrong sense
